claim_boundary: This is a bounded consumer-feedback proposal search for a fixed recipient-native mixer. It is not gradient training and it is not evidence of a general algebra: the basis, pair count, seeds, and proposal budget are small. The held-out scores are sealed from promotion. Native AB is an evaluation reference, never an inference input.

execution_receipt.instrument: frozen-consumer semantic composition mixer with Saturn checkpoint promotion

scheduling_contract.checkpoint_policy: one source checkpoint per pair/seed; all bounded mixer proposals replay the frozen suffix on one resident lease
